device_types.name: Vacuum switch / sensor

device_types.name: Barometric pressure sensor
device_types.description: MEMS absolute pressure sensor for altitude, floor detection and weather.

device_types.name: Shunt current sensor
device_types.description: Low-ohm resistor with amplifier/ADC measuring current by voltage drop; precise but not isolated.

device_types.name: Hall-effect current sensor
device_types.description: Open- or closed-loop Hall current transducer providing galvanic isolation for AC/DC currents.

device_types.name: Rogowski coil current sensor
device_types.description: Air-cored flexible coil with integrator for AC currents; no saturation, clamp-on installation.

device_types.name: Isolated voltage sensor

device_types.name: Thermocouple

device_types.name: RTD Pt1000
device_types.description: Platinum resistance thermometer, 1000 Ohm at 0 degC; lower lead-resistance sensitivity, suits 2-wire and low-power use.

device_types.name: NTC thermistor
device_types.description: Metal-oxide resistor with negative temperature coefficient; used for motor windings, batteries and boards.
